timing_policy: Consecutive calls inside each persistent isolated worker; no IPC between samples, synchronized every call, every output audited outside timing. Full public validation and NumPy I/O included; no output caching. Whole variant blocks run in a fixed order rotated across datasets.
cold_policy: First fit/query in each worker after imports, before steady blocks; startup and input construction excluded. Reported separately.
fit_policy: Fit measures eager work; fit_query constructs and queries a fresh estimator for every sample, including deferred preparation.
accuracy_reference: sklearn brute float64 on serialized float32 inputs; direct float64 selected distances and derived predictions, unchanged from mixed audit.

reference.source_state: working-tree snapshot; includes initial uncommitted KNN improvements
reference.purpose: Immutable complete package-source snapshot after initial KNN improvements, before the requested >=2x-default-sklearn acceleration. No data, fitted state or binaries.
reference.boundary: Complete sklearn-compatible and native MLX KNN search, input preparation, selection, refinement and prediction implementations.
